utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll keep asking around for a few more helpers and spread the word, too. If you hear anyone willing to pitch in, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — Ira’s already set to spread the word, and I’ll send anyone willing your way. We’ve also got Leo sorting tools and carrying parts, Oren making sure things are ready, and Dane bringing a notepad and spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — with Ira, Leo, Oren, and Dane on it, we’re in good shape. I’ll keep checking for a couple more helpers and send anyone I find your way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you spreading the word while you’re out. I’ll make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll tell folks while I’m out running errands. We should have a few people lined up by then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great — I’ll double-check the supplies and get everything set up. Thanks again for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’ll spread the word and ask around for a few volunteers for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep it lined up with the school schedule and sort the hand tools first. Gus is bringing a few tools too, so we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll keep people posted and send any updates I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I’ll have the first step ready when you swing by, and you can take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll help with whatever step you’ve got ready when I swing by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, I’ll have it ready when you come by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oren can write down what needs fixing and the timing, and I’d like a clear plan before I help. I’ll follow it once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Oren has to sort the plan and timing first, and then you’ll jump in, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s right — once Oren sets the plan and timing, I’ll help. And the repair drive is at the community hall on Maple Street tomorrow at 9.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over a few tools and lend a hand for the repair drive whenever you're ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll bring whatever tools I already have too. Opal’s keeping track, so I’ll check in with her about what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Bo — just let me know what’s still missing and I’ll bring over whatever tools are needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — that helps a lot. Ira’s spreading the word, and I’ll keep you posted on anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep listening and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring gloves and a couple screwdrivers, and I can help sort the tools and carry parts over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — Sunday at the community center is still the plan, and I’m walking over with Eli. If we need the exact address, Bo can send it over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll sort the hand tools and then check the parts boxes when Sam points me over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a maybe for the repair drive, and I’d feel better once the drop-off spot and time are confirmed. If Gus can lend tools, that might help too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s confirmed for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the sign-up sheet ready there. If Gus can lend tools, I can add that to the list too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot, thanks. I’m still a maybe, but Sunday at the community center sounds much easier to plan around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by later, sign the sheet, and check in with you after.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll be here—just remind me if I miss the sign sheet again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll stop by later, sign the sheet, and check in with you after.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — once we know what’s already covered, can you fill in the remaining gaps on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s still missing and fill in the gaps on the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo. What’s already covered on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep the details straight and stick to the school schedule. If anything changes on the repair drive, I’ll pass it along carefully.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll keep folks posted and make sure it stays lined up with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thank you, Tess — I’ll keep it tied to the school schedule and share any updates carefully. If Rey hears anything new, I’ll make sure it gets passed along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by the repair drive later, sign the sheet, and then check in with Noah afterward. Leo’s got gloves and a couple screwdrivers, and Gus can lend a few tools too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the gloves and screwdrivers, and I can sort tools or carry parts when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll stop by later, sign the sheet, and check in with Noah after. Thanks for bringing the gloves and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll make sure everything’s ready for the repair drive. And Vik said he’ll stop by later to sign the sheet and check in with you after.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks for the heads-up. I’ll watch for Vik after the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: And Ira’s going to spread the word while he’s out running errands, so we should have more folks looped in soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Opal’s tracking it, Faye’s working around the school schedule, Mina has gloves and blue tape, and Gus has the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, then I’ll keep an eye out and help wherever needed too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — that should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good call—let’s wait for a couple more helpers before we start. And if Noah’s right, Leo can bring the gloves and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good—then Dane can bring the notepad and spare tools, Mina has the gloves and blue masking tape, and Bo can handle the home list plus the community hall address on Maple Street. Ira’ll spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll keep the details straight—Dane brings the notepad and spare tools, and I’ll wait to hear if you find a couple more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Rosa can fill me in on how to help with the repair drive, and Quinn and Jules can keep spreading the word and lining up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep listening for updates and pass them along. If you hear the drop-off details and confirmed time, I can share them with Pia too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey — I’ll check with Rosa for the pitch-in details and let you know the drop-off time once I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late as usual, but I can still help out. I’ll check the supply list and see if there’s anything I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m happy to help too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll look over Cleo’s supply list and see what’s still missing. If you spot anything urgent, just let me know and I’ll bring it when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the repair drive list started with gloves, tape, and a few tools. Once we know what’s already covered, I’ll fill in the gaps and let Rey know the updates.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Cleo. Once Oren writes down the fixes and timing, I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that’ll help a lot. Once Oren’s notes are in, I can match the supplies and fill in whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over a few tools and lend a hand for the repair drive whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. I’ve got you down to bring your tools, and I’ll keep coordinating the rest.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll bring the tools over when you need them. Just give me a holler when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll have the first step ready for Dane. Thanks for keeping the sheet going, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll keep the sign-up sheet ready and add anyone who can help. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll be ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira’s already spreading the word, and Gus can bring over a few tools. Once we know what’s covered, Cleo can fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a maybe, but I’d feel better once the drop-off time and list are confirmed. Oren can note what needs fixing and when, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, Oren can note the fixes and the timing. I’ll confirm the drop-off time and list so you have the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m telling folks on the block to keep the repair drive in mind around the school schedule. Faye’s organizing it that way, so I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That still needs confirming for me—who’s doing the drop-offs, and what times are they set for?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the drop-off details yet, but I’ll check with Faye and get back to you. For now, just keep it in mind around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive. And it’s good to know Jules has Faye in mind for school pickup at 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira — 3:30 works as long as I can stay wrapped up with the school pickup. I’ll keep the repair drive lined up around that and coordinate the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that sounds good. I’ll keep folks posted on the repair drive, and with Leo and Oren helping, it should come together.
